name: Expressive Character Artwork Master Materialization
bounded_question: Can one optional expressive artwork master, generated from current Phase-C Character/image laws, provide enough cross-surface art-direction specificity to guide later app/website design while remaining subordinate to CPS-B and surviving fixed crop/reduction stress without palette, Stage or product-semantic dependence?
non_rerun_law: This is a new materialization namespace, not IMG-01 family rerun or IMG-F2 refinement.
IMG-F1 contributes reduced expressive-depiction laws only; its raw pixels are not renderer style reference.
IMG-F2 remains targeted-refinement-required and cannot be rescued by this output.
IMG-F3 remains rejected; environmental response is contextual/subordinate only.
CPS-B remains canonical beneath any optional depiction.

attempt_law.technical_retry_condition: Only a renderer/tool failure that returns no usable image bytes and no visually inspectable output. Any valid returned image consumes the gate attempt regardless of quality.
attempt_law.stop_consequence: A consumed output that does not survive is not repaired inside CHARART-01. Any successor/refinement requires a fresh audit and new frozen method.

renderer_isolation.execution_context: One fresh regular non-project image-generation chat.
renderer_isolation.renderer_sees_only: renderer_visible_prompt from the frozen renderer packet

controlled_scene_facts.people: Exactly three distinct, specific adults; A and B carry the strongest current relation; C remains specific and relevant.
controlled_scene_facts.time: Temporally non-specific present after one completed human action changed the shared situation; the act itself is over.
controlled_scene_facts.psychology: Do not explain or infer motive, belief, knowledge, diagnosis, emotion or hidden mental state.
controlled_scene_facts.identity: Each person uses sparse redundant non-color cues distributed across silhouette, proportion, contour, hair/body geometry and recurring form rhythm; face may contribute but may not be sole recognition authority.
controlled_scene_facts.environment: Sparse, quiet, subordinate shared field. Physical consequence may appear only where attributable to people and may not become spectacle.

composition_contract.blocking: Asymmetric shared composition, not a lineup or character-select sheet.

placement_pressure.C: primarily right 68–92% of width with deliberate vertical/depth offset

composition_contract.relation: A/B relation must emerge from orientation, overlap, shared contact/obstruction or negative space rather than connector graphics.
composition_contract.crop_margin: Keep sufficient authored body/form information inside the fixed crop windows; failure to do so is evidence, not a reason to move the crops.

art_direction_constraints: Authored stylized human figures; not photorealistic, fashion/editorial portraiture, profile-avatar imagery, game-character art or mascot design.
Human figures remain the strongest visual hierarchy; environment/material response never outranks them.
Planar to shallow spatial depth; no giant symbolic object, cinematic spectacle, magical energy, portals, beams, aura or decorative texture carpet.
No UI, text, labels, logos, arrows, nodes, diagram connectors, cone lineups, spotlight/theater composition or copied Stage geometry.
Do not prescribe a brand palette; value, form, contact and geometry must carry the result.
post_render_sequence: Immediately preserve the untouched raw output in authenticated Drive folder 16mixyRAIXVjLbY7vQVfaew_9Kim628vy before subjective evaluation.
Record exact Drive file ID, filename, SHA-256, byte count and pixel dimensions in GitHub evidence.
Construct only deterministic fixed crops and diagnostic grayscale/high-contrast/no-image review surfaces; never edit the raw master.
Run mechanical/source/provenance preflight before Design Sol subjective scoring.
Freeze the Design Sol method-bound view before any Director acceptance decision.
If the output survives, return the raw master plus fixed diagnostic crops to the Director for consequential acceptance/rejection. No automatic master promotion.

mechanical_preflight.raw_master: Readable raw image, expected landscape 16:9 within normal renderer tolerance; no corruption or unexpected embedded UI/text.
mechanical_preflight.crop_stress: Apply the five frozen normalized crop windows unchanged. Record whether the intended people/identity/relationship survive each window.
mechanical_preflight.no_image_law: Removing expressive artwork must not destroy canonical Character identity/task comprehension because CPS-B identity remains separate; this gate may not make the image semantically mandatory.
mechanical_preflight.motion: Static artwork only; no motion dependency.

hard_failures: Face/portrait becomes sole practical identity authority.
People collapse into generic avatars, mascots, game characters, fashion/editorial models or interchangeable AI figures.
Environment, material spectacle or giant symbolic object outranks the people.
Stage/cone/scenery shorthand is copied or recognizably recreated.
Private psychology, hidden-state inference or demographic stereotype becomes required meaning.
The fixed pair/focused/fragment crop stress destroys the authored human-specificity or relationship mechanism rather than merely reducing decoration.
promotion_floor: SURVIVES_FOR_DIRECTOR_REVIEW only if HUMAN_SPECIFICITY, CPS_B_SUBORDINATION, DISTRIBUTED_NONCOLOR_RECOVERY, RELATIONAL_CAUSAL_MEANING, FIXED_CROP_SURVIVAL, ENVIRONMENT_SUBORDINATION, ANTI_AVATAR_EDITORIAL_GAME, STAGE_PRIMACY_NONCOPY, PERSPECTIVE_PRIVACY_RESTRAINT and PROVENANCE_REPRODUCIBILITY all pass with no hard failure. NON_GENERIC_AI_ART_DIRECTION and APP_WEB_OPTIONAL_DEPLOYMENT must be explicitly judged and may impose restraint but cannot be ignored.
result_classes: SURVIVES_FOR_DIRECTOR_REVIEW — clears the frozen floor; Director acceptance remains required before master authority.
TARGETED_REFINEMENT_REQUIRED_NO_SAME_GATE_RERENDER — concept retains value but consumed output misses one or more non-hard dimensions; no repair in this gate.
REJECTED — hard failure or broad inability to satisfy the frozen expressive-master role.

director_gate.question: Does the method-bound surviving raw master feel sufficiently Kymaean, human, specific and non-generic to become the current Phase-C expressive artwork master under CPS-B restraint?

explicit_non_authority: No canonical Character identity transfer from artwork; CPS-B remains canonical.
No CLR family/palette selection or production color token.
No Stage/Stage-to-shell geometry or scenery authority.
No product semantics, Character biography or private-state authority.
No Phase-C exit, Phase-D entry, native/runtime/provider/shipping/Store authority.
required_outputs: one raw Drive master or documented technical no-output failure
Director decision only if the output survives for review
